fixed_risks: Home Office announcement pages containing Published metadata no longer create a false publication state.
Non-HTML responses without a supported artifact signature are no longer accepted.
ONS and Home Office links are unlocked only by their own verified publication state.
Output publication is atomic and fail-closed.

rows.evidence: HTTPS ONS/GOV.UK accepted; HTTP and external hosts rejected.
Fragments and utm_* parameters removed while functional query values remain.
External links removed and canonical duplicates collapsed.
Not-yet-published marker overrides release-like text.
ONS publication requires expected title, exact Released marker, Publications and Data.
Announcement metadata cannot become a published product.
Non-announcement product with expected title, Documents and Published is accepted.
Artifact classes assigned and pre-release access lists excluded.
ZIP-container signature accepts XLSX/ODS/ZIP payloads.
Spreadsheet extension with wrong signature is rejected.
HTML response masquerading as CSV is rejected.
Expected ONS bulletin identity is accepted as an official HTML product.
Page-not-found HTML is rejected.
Unpublished release yields zero inspected and accepted artifacts.
ONS publication does not unlock pending Home Office links.
Output uses fsync plus atomic replace and leaves no temp file.
ONS and Home Office publication states are stored independently.
Published metadata on an announcement is not a release signal.
Only HTTPS on ONS/GOV.UK hosts is permitted.
Every redirect target is checked before following.
Tracking parameters and fragments do not inflate artifact counts.
Only two attempts are allowed for transient HTTP/network failures.
Release pages are capped at 5 MiB.
Artifacts are capped at 80 MiB.
Invalid, negative or oversized declared lengths are rejected.
XLSX/ODS/XLS/PDF/CSV payloads require compatible signatures or structure.
HTML artifacts require expected ONS/Home Office product identity.
Known error-page markers cannot pass as official products.
HTTP status, final URL, content type, exact bytes and SHA-256 are recorded.
Figures ingested and direct score inputs remain zero; AREA_LEVEL_PROXY is preserved.
Interrupted writes cannot leave a partially valid JSON receipt.
V2 collector and test files were re-fetched from the canonical branch with exact Git blob SHAs.
